Name: Custom Critters
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Lets content packs add custom critters to the world.
Description:
**Custom Critters** lets content packs add custom critters to the world.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**

*   **For players:** just install the mod and it'll work automatically for content packs that use it (see __Dependencies__ > __Mods requiring this file__ above).

*   **For mod authors:** see [example content pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1259).
**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/CustomCritters/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
